features: Designed for Kids: The Punnk Funnk Kids Smart Watch is specifically designed with the safety and needs of children in mind. It offers a range of features that provide peace of mind for parents while allowing kids to have fun and stay connected.

LBS Tracking and Safety: The Punnk Funnk Kids Smart Watch utilizes LBS technology to provide accurate and real-time tracking of your child's location. Stay informed about their whereabouts and ensure their safety.

Two-Way Communication: The smartwatch allows seamless communication between parents and children. With voice calls and messages, parents can easily reach out to their child and vice versa, promoting a sense of security and connectivity.

SOS Emergency Function: In case of emergencies, the Punnk Funnk Kids Smart Watch features an SOS button that children can press to send an immediate distress signal to their parents or guardians, ensuring quick assistance.

Safe Zones and Geofencing: Set up safe zones and geofencing boundaries with the smartwatch, receiving alerts whenever your child enters or exits a designated area. It enhances child safety and provides peace of mind.
Note: Jio & BSNL Sim not supported with this Kids Smartwatch.
